rl.title: RL short test on Ornith 9B: all 3 steps done
rl.intro: Three training steps of 16 attempts each, on Terminal-Bench 2 training tasks in Prime sandboxes. 4 H200 GPUs on Hugging Face ($20/h); started 12:14 p.m., steps done 12:52 p.m.; saving the final weights now.
rl.note: The whole pipeline works: the model runs, the agent works in sandboxes, rewards come back, and the trainer updates the weights. Prime still shuts some sandboxes down mid-run; those attempts are retried. Getting here took three failed starts (~$5): two missing packages and a GPU-count setting. This run: about $14 so far.

qwen.title: Qwen3.8-27B on your 3090: speed
qwen.intro: New engine (TensorFold) with a small draft model that guesses several words ahead; the big model checks every guess, so its answers don't change.
qwen.context: Longest prompt that fits: about 42K tokens (24.0 of 24.5 GB). The old EXL3 setup fits 262K, so context is now the thing to win back.
qwen.next: Next: cut the memory each token of context costs (an extra copy, then 8-bit storage), then a 3-bit/4-bit mix of the weights, each checked against the full model for lost intelligence.
